intro.id: Semua polis OSHC wajib memenuhi standar minimum pemerintah Australia. Perbedaannya ada di batas obat resep, layanan tambahan, dan masa tunggu. Harga per bulan mengikuti pilihan OSHC di atas.
intro.en: All OSHC policies must meet the Australian Government minimum. They differ in prescription limits, extra services and waiting periods. Monthly prices follow the OSHC selector above.

disclaimer.id: Ringkasan informasi umum dari dokumen resmi masing-masing asuransi (tanggal cek tercantum), bukan saran asuransi. Benefit, limit, dan masa tunggu bisa berubah - baca dokumen polis atau tanya konsultan Talented sebelum membeli. Biaya selisih (gap) dokter bisa berlaku.
disclaimer.en: General summary from each insurer's official documents (check date shown), not insurance advice. Benefits, limits and waiting periods can change - read the policy documents or ask a Talented consultant before buying. Doctor gap fees may apply.

id: Rawat inap rumah sakit (public/private sesuai jaringan) dan operasi
Masa tunggu tidak berlaku untuk perawatan darurat
Dental, optik, fisioterapi TIDAK termasuk di polis dasar
Mulai 1 Jan 2026 asuransi mulai menghapus masa tunggu kehamilan untuk polis 2 tahun atau lebih
en: Hospital admission (public/private per network) and surgery
Waiting periods do not apply to emergency treatment
Dental, optical and physio are NOT included in basic policies
From 1 Jan 2026 insurers began removing pregnancy waiting periods for policies of 2+ years

product.en: ahm OSHC (part of the Medibank group)

gp.id: Menanggung GP, spesialis, tes darah & rontgen (minimal 85% MBS sesuai standar pemerintah; persentase pasti di Member Guide)
gp.en: Covers GP, specialists, blood tests & x-rays (at least 85% MBS per government minimum; exact % in the Member Guide)

pharmacy.id: Minimal standar pemerintah: s.d. AUD 50/item, AUD 500/tahun (single) - konfirmasi di Cover Summary ahm
pharmacy.en: Government minimum: up to AUD 50/item, AUD 500/year (single) - confirm in ahm Cover Summary

waiting.id: Lihat Member Guide ahm (umumnya 12 bln kondisi bawaan & kehamilan)
waiting.en: See ahm Member Guide (typically 12 months pre-existing & pregnancy)

perks.id: Klaim dibayar ke rekening dalam 2 hari kerja; aplikasi & daftar provider direct billing; ahm Student Rewards (diskon Apple, Samsung, Hoyts, Uber)
perks.en: Claims paid to your bank within 2 business days; app & direct-billing provider list; ahm Student Rewards (Apple, Samsung, Hoyts, Uber offers)

gp.id: GP 100% MBS; spesialis, tes darah & rontgen 85% MBS
gp.en: GP 100% MBS; specialist, blood tests & x-rays 85% MBS

pharmacy.id: S.d. AUD 50/item; AUD 500/tahun single, AUD 1.000 dual/keluarga
pharmacy.en: Up to AUD 50/item; AUD 500/year single, AUD 1,000 dual/family

waiting.id: Kondisi bawaan 12 bln; kehamilan 12 bln (tidak ada bila polis >= 2 tahun); psikiatri tanpa masa tunggu
waiting.en: Pre-existing 12 mths; pregnancy 12 mths (none if policy >= 2 years); no psychiatric waiting period

perks.id: Aplikasi Allianz MyHealth; helpline darurat 24/7; dukungan di kampus tertentu
perks.en: Allianz MyHealth app; 24/7 emergency helpline; on-campus support at participating campuses

upgrade.en: OSHC Essentials: prescriptions AUD 750/year single (AUD 1,500 family), extra psychology up to AUD 50/consult, medical repatriation up to AUD 100,000

gp.id: S.d. 100% MBS tanpa batas tahunan; Medical Gap Scheme saat rawat inap (gap s.d. AUD 500 atau nol bila dokter ikut)
gp.en: Up to 100% MBS, no yearly limit; Medical Gap Scheme in hospital (gap up to AUD 500 or none if the doctor participates)

pharmacy.id: S.d. AUD 50/item; AUD 500/orang, AUD 1.000/polis per tahun

mental.id: Psikiatri rumah sakit & mental health care plan (MBS) ditanggung
